title: Scan intake
summary: Read the scan: voxel size, dimensions, calibration, and anything wrong with the files.
instructions: Read the scan header and the files in /inputs: voxel spacing, size, orientation, and any problem with the data. Write what you found for the later tasks, and the notes' account of the field in /outputs/intake/scan-notes.md (scan-intake skill).
doneWhen: The spacing and size come from the files themselves, with the file or header each came from.

title: Orientation
summary: Align the knee so femur and tibia sit on their shaft axes, one frame for every later task.
instructions: Orient the stack so the later tasks share one frame (a labels-ready volume with known axes), with the orient-joint skill.
doneWhen: The keyframe cuts the femur and the tibia through the joint, and the patella when it is in the field, as examples/README.md (orientation) describes.

title: Segmentation
summary: Segment the bones and joint structures; a piece the data don’t support isn’t named.
instructions: Segment the bones and joint structures and settle the final labels; a piece the data do not support is not named, and whether its structure is absent is decided by the segmentation-check skill, section 2.
doneWhen: Every label is one structure and every piece present is labelled or raised as a To check item, checked on the 3D sheet and the label checks, as examples/README.md (segmentation) describes.
The volumes of #1-3 follow from the final labels.

title: Tibial IIOC
summary: Define ROI-1 from the growth plate to the articular surface; report its volumes, heights and the tibial width.
instructions: Define the IIOC region (ROI-1) and report its volumes, heights and the tibial width. Write the aligned frame to /outputs/iioc/frame/ and the ROI-1 files to /outputs/iioc/iioc/: the later tibial tasks read them there.
doneWhen: ROI-1 runs from the growth plate to the articular surface, as examples/README.md (iioc) describes, and was checked on a render.

title: Subchondral bone plate
summary: Measure subchondral bone plate thickness, medial and lateral.
instructions: Measure the subchondral bone plate thickness, medial and lateral.
doneWhen: Each slab sits inside the plate under the articular surface, as examples/README.md (subchondral-plate) describes, and each thickness is reported with the render it was read from.

title: IIOC trabecular bone
summary: Define ROI-2: ROI-1 without the plate and the cortical line; report its volumes.
instructions: Define ROI-2 (ROI-1 without the plate and the cortical line) and report its volumes.
doneWhen: ROI-2 excludes the subchondral plate and the cortical line, as examples/README.md (trabecular-roi) describes.

title: Proximal tibial metaphysis
summary: Define ROI-3, 50–250 µm below the growth plate and 20 µm clear of cortex; report its trabecular parameters.
instructions: Define ROI-3 below the growth plate and report its trabecular parameters. Write them to /outputs/metaphyseal-roi/meta/: the cortical task reads cortex.npy and growth-plate-distal-face.npy there.
doneWhen: ROI-3 starts 50 um below the growth plate, is 200 um long and 20 um clear of cortical bone, as examples/README.md (metaphyseal-roi) describes.

title: Tibial cortical thickness
summary: Measure cortical thickness 100 µm and 1000 µm below the growth plate.
instructions: Measure the cortical thickness 100 um and 1000 um below the growth plate. Use the cortex mask and distal growth-plate face that metaphyseal-roi wrote (/outputs/metaphyseal-roi/meta/cortex.npy and /outputs/metaphyseal-roi/meta/growth-plate-distal-face.npy); do not trace the face again.
doneWhen: Both levels are measured on the cortex mask and distal face of metaphyseal-roi, as examples/README.md (cortical) describes.

title: Distal femur
summary: Place the femoral landmarks and measure distal femoral length, width and their ratio.
instructions: Place the femoral points and report the distal femoral length, width and their ratio.
doneWhen: Points a-d sit where examples/README.md (femoral-geometry) puts them, each checked on a second view, and the lengths follow from them.
